name: Batık Keşfi
scene: A vintage exploration submarine with three round portholes and a raised periscope glides through flowing underwater currents.
notes: Target 31–41 panes. Warm submarine and cool water use separate colour pairs. Reviewed both generations; the single revision removed the four-way hull crossings and concentric porthole rings. Remaining doubts: subtle generated fill shading, some same-colour neighbouring water panes, and closely spaced contacts at the tail and conning tower need attention during tracing. No obvious loose line ends. Design sheet only; not geometry-audited or published.
